reviews.title: Watch haptic feedback behavior change?
reviews.text:
I love this app, hence the 5 star rating. However, it seems as if the haptic behavior on the Watch has changed for the worse (IMO). There used to be a one single prominent tap in between each breath, but it seems like now, it’s a series of very light taps during each breath. With my haptic setting at Prominent in the Watch app, I can still barely feel it beneath the sound of my breath. Using the voice is way too intrusive (again, IMO), so that’s not an option for me. 

Am I imagining this?

reviews.title: Solid app for helping you do breath work
reviews.text:
Could use an update. The are three preset breathing methods and one custom setting. The custom could be made better by a longer duration, current one is about 16 minutes. Also, you can only do whole seconds. No half second methods such as the “perfect breath” of 5.5 inhale and 5.5 exhale as defined by James Nestor. 

Also, a second custom setting would be awesome. 

Solid app though, I use it multiple times per day and did the paid version.

Edit* the app has been updated several times since my review and it’s perfect now. The dev is awesome.

reviews.title: Simple and useful
reviews.text: This app is simple and intuitive to use. A simple and elegant user interface actually takes a lot of thought and effort to design. Thank you! One suggestion is that for signal options, the non-human voice choices should be sets of three sounds, instead of single sounds. Currently, if I choose “Bell 1”, this same sound is played for inhale, hold, and exhale. I lose track quickly. If instead it is something like “sound set 1” with three different sounds, one for each breathing stop, it will work much better. For breathing and meditation, I find human voices distracting and chimes more agreeable.

reviews.title: Ads are loud, jarring, frequent, and defeat the app’s purpose
reviews.text:
The app itself seemed decent. Limited functionality with the free version, but hey - that’s the ‘premium’ side of ‘freemium’ apps, right?

Then I finished my first breathing exercise. I was relaxed!

And then an ad started _shouting _ in my ear. What on earth were you thinking?

I get that you all still need to make $ off of us cheapskates (though after one session is a bit quick). But with audible, LOUD ads just after helping us release some stress?

I can’t fathom how you got your rating, unless you’ve changed your UI a ton in recent years
